messages.author: e6c87266ffc5f0f2
messages.subject: Spacing between bars
parts:
Hello,

Can someone point me to tips what to do in a bar chart where bars
require long titles underneath? (e.g., 'Greedy select A') The problem
is that all the titles overlap. Can I rotate the title 90 degree?

Thanks.

messages.author: 5ec5102a43e29af7
messages.subject: Re: Spacing between bars
parts:
hello,

rotating x labels:
... + opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(angle = 90))


regards,
Stefan
